overview: The Medford Board of Health voted to adjust the citywide residential heating season end date to May 15 and granted a plan review requirement variance for a local restaurant.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the March 21, 2023 meeting.

items.title: Housing Code Heating Season Alteration
items.summary: Approved ending the residential heating season on May 15 citywide in accordance with updated state housing code regulations.

items.title: Tacuba Food Establishment Plan Review Variance
items.summary: Granted a variance waiving the certified food consultant signature requirement for Tacuba's resubmitted plan review application after the city lost the original file.
